help.title: Help
help.intro: MeetingLens is currently a development preview for testing the local desktop meeting workflow.
help.availableBody: You can create, start, end, review and delete synthetic meetings; import and manage local meeting files; inspect mock Provider and authenticated Sidecar status; and safely store a DeepSeek API key.
help.unavailableBody: Real recording, realtime transcription, pasted or imported transcripts, real AI minutes, screen capture, speaker diarization, realtime translation and video import are not implemented.
help.quickStartBody: Create a meeting, start the synthetic flow, review the in-memory transcript, end the meeting, and confirm it appears in history.
help.filesBody: Open a meeting and use Add files. Approved files are copied into private application storage and can be deleted without changing the source file. Docling is not connected to this UI yet.
help.deepseekBody: Use Settings to save the key in Windows Credential Manager. The value cannot be read back by the WebView, and no real DeepSeek Provider uses it in this preview.
help.privacyBody: Meeting metadata and imported copies stay in MeetingLens private local storage. The preview does not record audio, read the screen or send meeting content to external AI.
help.faqBody: Changing the interface language does not change meeting data or the future minutes output language. Clearing WebView storage only resets the interface-language preference.
help.feedbackBody: When reporting a problem, include the action, safe error code and application version. Never attach API keys, recordings, meeting content, local databases or private paths.
help.guidesBody: The repository includes matching Simplified Chinese and English development-preview guides.
